findings.label: Upload-failure test is a tautology
findings.detail: uploadFailurePath_keepsLocalOutputDir never invokes deleteLocalOutputDir and never drives processJobAsync, then asserts the output dir still exists. The assertion holds trivially because nothing in the test touches the directory, so it would pass even if the success-path gating were broken. The production gating (localUploadedToCustomerOrAccount staying false on a throw) is correct; the test just does not prove it. Strengthen it to mock a throwing uploadDirectory and assert no deletion, or acknowledge it only documents intent.
